'''Tempest Scout 2''' was an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]] in [[Tempest Force]]. Its callsign was '''''17-B'''''. It first saw battle on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], and was later assigned to coordinate battle activities with the [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout trooper]] detachments on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].

==History==
[[File:Tempestscout2.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Tempest Scout 2]]
It was [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Marquand/Legends|Marquand]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Watts]] served as [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]]. The vehicle was commandeered by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and two [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], [[Widdle Warrick/Legends|Widdle Warrick]] and [[Wunka/Legends|Wunka]], who threw Watts out and knocked Marquand unconscious. They then used the vehicle to destroy several other AT-STs, turning the tide of the battle in favor of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] ground forces.<ref name="ROJ" /> Midway through, however, the Imperials became privy to Tempest Scout 2's actions and began targeting it, although they believed that the pilots simply turned traitor, not realizing that it was actually hijacked.<ref name="RS III">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>

It later rendezvoused with the strike team after most of the Imperials were wiped out, although the strike team survivors were initially concerned at its arrival, being unaware of Chewbacca and the Ewoks hijacking the vehicle earlier until Chewbacca revealed himself to them. Afterwards, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] posed as one of the scout pilots using the captured walker to trick the Imperials into opening the [[Endor shield generator bunker|bunker]] for them as well as surround them.<ref name="ROJ" />

Following the destruction of the shield bunker, the walker was given to [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]] to perform final cleanup operations.<ref name="BFRS">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' CD-ROM identified this walker as "Scout Walker Seven" in [[1998]],<ref name="BtM" /> but [[Decipher]]'s ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]'' [[Endor Limited]] set released in [[1999]] instead called it Tempest Scout 2.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Tempest Scout 2}}</ref>
